reason: While the simulation passes all verification checks and is robust and configurable, there remain significant model accuracy gaps between the simulation and the real-world system. Critical issues—such as lack of spatial/network structure, agent heterogeneity, and limited validation metrics—have been clearly identified and can be addressed in the next iteration. Since this is only iteration 1 of 3, there is ample room and strong justification for another round focused on substantial model improvements.
